communications.subject: Nevada Public Records Act Request: Caleb Briggs Autopsy
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Autopsy report of Caleb Briggs DOD 12/06/2023

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Annemarie Grant

title: Chatham County: AP Invoice Detail for Selected Vendors, 2020 to Present.

communications.subject: Georgia Open Records Act Request: Chatham County: AP Invoice Detail for Selected Vendors, 2020 to Present.
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

An accounts-payable invoice listing or vendor ledger from the County’s financial system showing every payment to every vendor, for all County departments and offices, including the Police Department and the Sheriff’s Office, from July 1, 2020 through the date of this request. Please do not limit it to vendors paid solely for one department; include payments charged to more than one department or cost center.

For each payment, please include every field the standard accounts-payable listing contains, and at least: vendor number and name, invoice number and date, payment or check date and number, amount, purchase order number, department or cost center, and GL account or fund. If the system keeps a project or grant code, please include it.

Please provide the data in a CSV or Excel export with column headings rather than a PDF, as O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(f) allows, together with a short description of each column so the fields can be read correctly.

Because the data covers several fiscal years, please provide one export per fiscal year, starting with the most recent (FY2027 to date, then FY2026, FY2025, and so on), and send each as it is ready. If the estimate for the older years is high, please send it before doing the work and I will narrow the years.

Optional, delete if you don’t want it: I do not need the names of individual (non-business) payees. If it is easier, those names may be replaced with the vendor number.

If any part cannot be released, please tell me which part and the specific legal authority by Code section, subsection, and paragraph, as O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(d) provides, and release the rest. I do not authorize any work that would exceed $25 until I have approved the estimate.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ethan Watters
